key_insight: InterGenEHR+ generates synthetic EHR records and longitudinal patient trajectories conditioned on natural-language clinical scenarios.
clinical_relevance: The framework could support scenario-based evaluation of machine learning models in data-sparse critical care settings.
method: An optional LLM parser translates clinical requests into structured constraints.
Conditional variational autoencoders and diffusion models generate single-time-point records.
evidence_signal: Evaluation in a multi-institutional cohort of 874 VV-ECMO patients assessed fidelity, constraint adherence, and clinician-rated plausibility; across five seeds and three classifiers, synthetic cohorts retained mortality-prediction utility on real test data.
watch_item: Findings are limited to the evaluated VV-ECMO cohort; other clinical settings require further validation.
paper_title: InterGenEHR$^+$: An Interactive Framework for Natural Language-Conditioned Generation of Longitudinal Patient Trajectories
